fields.description: One way money reaches this company — Cash at the desk, GCash, or a bank account. Set up by the platform for each tenant; Cash and GCash are created with the company. Disable a channel to hide it from every new payment; it stays on the payments that already used it.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: Tenant: one of this company's own channels. Platform: a channel the platform itself is paid through (recorded on platform statements).
fields.label: Scope

fields.description: What customers and staff see in the picker — "GCash", "BDO", "Cash".
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Cash pairs with the Cash payment method (confirms on the spot). Transfer pairs with Fund Transfer (proof hold) — GCash, Maya and every bank are Transfer. Fixed once created.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: Off: hidden from every new payment (desk dialogs, checkout, proof upload) and kept on old ones. A channel with payments on it can never be deleted — only disabled.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Picker order; the first enabled channel of a kind is the default.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: How this channel appears in the tenant's books (docs/collection_flow_v1.md): the Mode of Payment name and the asset account it debits.
fields.label: For the ledger

fields.description: The ERPNext Mode of Payment name this channel maps to. Defaults to the label.
fields.label: Mode of Payment

fields.description: The asset account name printed on the Tenant Ledger — e.g. "Cash on Hand", "Cash in E-Wallet - GCash", "BDO Current Account". Defaults from the kind / label.
fields.label: Ledger Account

fields.description: Shown to customers at checkout and on the booking page so they know where to send the money. This is a PUBLIC surface (the booking page is open to logged-out visitors).
fields.label: Shown to customers

fields.description: Optional QR code image (GCash / bank QR).
fields.label: QR Image

fields.description: Optional one-line note for this channel ("send the screenshot to the desk").
fields.label: Instructions
